structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12-minute-old copy of Effective Accelerationism (e/acc) on a PumpSwap pool, created directly rather than migrated from a pump.fun curve (migrated_unix=0, launchpad unknown). It copies the UsePaid fee-routing description that sends fees to @beffjezos. The canonical-looking e/acc token (CbcyNo...) launched about 3.6h earlier and sits at about $9.2M mcap with $1.3M hourly volume. This copy is at $28k mcap and liquidity ($38k) is larger than mcap. That means a creator-seeded pool with 100% of LP unlocked, and the creator has closed out. Of 876 holders, 867 are fresh wallets, and 45 are bundler wallets.
